Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players have made their way out to the middle. Sarfaraz Ali and Muhammad Younis are the openers for Bahrain. Mark Adair to start with the ball.
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! 159 is what Bahrain need to make history. On the other hand, Ireland would fancy their chances of defending this total. Should be an exciting chase. Do join us for the second essay which begins shortly.

The bowlers of Bahrain couldn't stop the run flow at the start but it was once again, Junaid Aziz who work his magic with the ball and got both the set openers. After that, they maintained the pressure and did well to contain runs. However, they leaked plenty of runs at the death and dropped a couple of catches as well which proved to be very costly.

Andy Balbirnie and Paul Stirling provided a good start for Ireland but both got out in their 30's. After that, Harry Tector and Lorcan Tucker couldn't contribute much and fell for a cheap score. However, George Dockrell and Gareth Delany stitched a nice partnership and got Ireland's innings back on track. Gareth Delany made sure Ireland flourish well in the end and has given his side a solid chance of winning this match.

Ireland have scored 58 runs in the last 5 overs and they would be pretty happy with this total considering it's a do-or-die game for them. Bahrain bowled well for the most part of the game but they know that they could have restricted Ireland to below 130 but they allowed the momentum to shift away and that would hurt them.
Fuller and wider, outside off. Gareth Delany drives it through covers and comes back for the second run. Delany also brings up his FIFTY on the last ball of the innings. Ireland end with 158/5.
Short of a length, outside off. Gareth Delany pumps it over the bowler's head and takes a couple of runs.

OUT! TAKEN! Finally, Bahrain take one and Imran Anwar gets rid of George Dockrell. A full ball, outside off. George Dockrell looks to go over long off but it goes off the toe end towards Haider Ali Butt at long off who takes a juggling catch. Mark Adair walks out to bat.
Commentary.Howout: c Haider Ali Butt b Imran Anwar

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on off. Gareth Delany pushes it to the off side for a run.
Short of a length, outside off. Gareth Delany drags it towards long on and picks up a couple of runs.
SIX! BANG! Delany is playing a very handy knock for his side here! A full ball, on middle. Gareth Delany sits back and smokes it over the long on region for a biggie.
Good effort in the field! Another ball, full and on middle. George Dockrell drills it towards the long on region where the fielder dives and saves a couple of runs.
A yorker-length ball, on middle. Gareth Delany squeezes it out to the off side and manages only a single.
SIX! Take that, says Delany! A full ball, on middle. Gareth Delany sits back and bludgeons it over long on for a biggie.
Put down again! Length ball, outside off. Gareth Delany slices it towards deep extra cover. The fielder there comes underneath but fails to hold on. Two runs taken!
A full ball, on middle. Gareth Delany lofts it back over the bowler's head and comes back for the second run.
Back of a length, on off. George Dockrell drags it towards deep square leg and manages only a run.
Shahid Mahmood (2-0-16-0) comes on.
A yorker-length delivery, on middle. Gareth Delany digs it out back to the bowler.
PUT DOWN! A length ball, on middle. Gareth Delany tonks it towards the deep mid-wicket region but straight to the fielder. The fielder there makes a mess of it and the batters take two runs.
Flatter and quicker, on middle. George Dockrell works it through the leg side for a single.
SIX! WHACKED! On a length, around off. Dockrell gets under it and sends it sailing over the deep mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
FOUR! This is tossed up, on middle. Dockrell prods and whacks it through the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary. Ireland need many of these!
Flatter ball, on middle. Gareth Delany plays it to the leg side and collects a single.
Floated, fuller in length, outside off. George Dockrell drives it wide of long off and takes a couple of runs.
Slightly shorter in length, outside off. Gareth Delany punches it towards deep cover and rotates the strike.
Flatter and quicker, on off. Gareth Delany keeps it out.
Looped up, on middle. Gareth Delany flicks it through mid-wicket and collects a couple of runs.
On off, this is pushes towards cover for a run.
SIX! BOOM! This is tossed up, around off. George Dockrell smacks it over long off and collects a maximum.
Around off. Gareth Delany works it towards mid-wicket.

FOUR BYES! That has missed everything! A flatter ball, just outside off. Gareth Delany looks to heave it away but he misses and the ball goes just over the stumps. The keeper fails to grab it and it races away to the fence.
Tossed up, around off. Gareth Delany blocks it off the front foot.
Flatter ball, on middle. Dockrell nudges it to the leg side and takes a single.
Outside off. George Dockrell keeps it out.
George Dockrell is the new batsman in.

OUT! LBW! The skipper strikes and Ireland lose their fourth wicket now! This is tossed up, on middle. Lorcan Tucker looks to sweep by getting down on his knee. He misses and is pinged on his pad. Ali appeals and the umpire raises his finger.
A full toss, on middle. Lorcan Tucker sweeps it to deep mid-wicket and keeps the strike. End of a brilliant spell from Junaid Aziz. His figures read 4-0-16-2!
Short and outside off, Gareth Delany punches it to long off for a single.
Outside off, worked to long off for a run.
Flighted delivery, outside off. Gareth Delany comes down thet track and drives it to deep cover only for a run.
Loopy ball, outside off. Gareth Delany drives it to cover.
Full and on middle, Lorcan Tucker sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played! Full and flatter, on leg. Gareth Delany clears his front leg and whacks it to long on for a boundary.
This is eased down to long on for a single.
Loopy ball, outside off. Lorcan Tucker chops it on the off side.
On off, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, steered to deep point for a single.
WIDE! Short and way too outside off. Left alone. Wided.
SIX! Smoked! Tossed up, outside off. Gareth Delany stands tall and tonks it over long off for a biggie. Much-needed for Ireland!
Short and on middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full and on off, pushed towards covers for a single.
On the pads, nudged to square leg for a singe.
Lorcan Tucker walks out to bat.

RUN OUT! Ireland lose their third wicket and are in trouble now. Loopy ball, outside off. Tector smacks it straight to long off. The batters take a single. Delany is interested for the second run and starts running. Tector responds to that but then Delany pulls off and the throw from Sathaiya Veerapathiran is a good one as Aziz whips the bails off and Tector is caught short of his crease.
Flighted ball, outside off. Driven straight to covers.
Slower through the air, on off. Gareth Delany drives it to wide of long off for a single.
Loopy ball, on leg. Harry Tector paddles it to fine leg. The fielder from deep square leg runs across and does well to keep it down to only a couple.
On off, punched down to long off for one.
Outside off, Harry Tector cuts it to backward point and rotates the strike.
This is pushed down to long on for just a single.
Flatter ball, on off. Pushed towards covers.
Tossed up, outside off. Harry Tector drives it through covers for a run.
Short and outside off, Harry Tector cuts it to deep extra cover for a single. Another good over for Bahrain! A wicket and 3 runs off it.
Tossed up, on off. Gareth Delany plays it down to long off. He crosses ends.
A full toss, on middle. Harry Tector sweeps it to mid-wicket for a run.
Loopy ball, outside off. Driven towards covers.
Harry Tector walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! This is a huge wicket as Junaid Aziz gets the big fish! Aziz bowls it slower through the air, on middle. Paul Stirling looks to push it towards long on but he ends up chipping it straight back to the bowler. Junaid Aziz takes a sitter.
Floated, fuller in length, outside off. Paul Stirling drags it back to the bowler.
Fuller in length, on middle and leg. Paul Stirling works it back past the bowler towards mid on and collects a single.
Delany punches this length ball towards long off and takes a run.
Flatter ball, on the pads. Paul Stirling plays it on the leg side and rotates the strike.
Floated, on a length, around middle. Gareth Delany flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Loopy ball, outside off. Gareth Delany drives but straight back to the bowler.
Flatter and quicker, on off. Paul Stirling covers the line of the ball and tucks it to the leg side for a run.
Sarfaraz Ali to operate now.
Shorter in length and outside off. Paul Stirling taps it towards point for a quick run.
Flatter ball, on off. Paul Stirling keeps it out.
Gareth Delany walks out to bat at No.3.

OUT! TAKEN! Junaid Aziz strikes and gets the much-needed breakthrough for Bahrain. A full toss, around middle. Andy Balbirnie heaves it away uppishly towards the deep square leg region where Shahid Mahmood takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Shahid Mahmood b Junaid Aziz

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and quicker, on off. Andy Balbirnie keeps it out.
Flatter ball, outside off. Paul Stirling cuts it to sweeper cover for one run.
Tossed up, outside off. Andy Balbirnie drives it through covers for a single.
Junaid Aziz comes into the attack.
Back of a length, outside off. Paul Stirling looks to cut but he misses.
SIX! BOOM! This is a full ball, on off. Paul Stirling prods and lofts it way over the long off fence for a biggie.
Good-length ball, on middle. Andy Balbirnie nudges it to the leg side and settles for a run.
Short of a length, outside off. Paul Stirling drags it towards long on and takes a single.
On a length, on middle. Paul Stirling looks to heave it away but he gets an inside edge towards short fine leg.
Full ball, on off. Andy Balbirnie drives it down to long on for a run.
FOUR! Nicely done! Tossed up, on middle. Paul Stirling kneels and sweeps it through the square leg region for a boundary.
Flatter ball, outside off. Paul Stirling taps it to the off side.
DROPPED! This is tossed up, outside off. Paul Stirling looks to push it through the off side but he gets an outside edge towards the keeper who fails to gather it cleanly.
Loopy ball, outside off. Andy Balbirnie pushes it through covers for a run.
Darted on the pads. Paul Stirling tucks it towards mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Tossed up, on a length, outside off. Paul Stirling leaves it alone.
Back of a length, outside off. Paul Stirling punches it through covers for a run. Ireland are 45/0 at the end of the Powerplay.
Fuller in length, outside off. Andy Balbirnie pushes it towards mid off and collects a single.
This is on a length, on middle. Andy Balbirnie heaves it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Full ball, outside off. Paul Stirling drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Short of a length, on off. Paul Stirling keeps it out.
Full ball, on middle. Clipped towards square leg for a single.
Fraction short, on off. Punched towards covers off the back foot.
Full and on off, driven to sweeper cover for one.
Tosses it up, on middle. Andy Balbirnie sweeps it to square leg. The fielder there misfields and allows the batters to take a couple of runs.
Loopy ball, on middle. Andy Balbirnie keeps it out.
On off, driven towards cover.
Floats it up, outside off. Andy Balbirnie cuts it to point.
On the pads, it is clipped to deep square leg for a single.
Full and on middle, nudged to mid-wicket for a run.
On a length, on off. Andy Balbirnie drives it to mid off for a quick single.
SIX! BANG! In the slot, outside off. Balbirnie shimmies down and lofts it over long off for a biggie.
On a length, on off. Driven straight to mid off.
FOUR! Back of a length, outside off. Balbirnie picks it up and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
A dot to end! Full and outside off, Paul Stirling drives it straight to the cover fielder. Just 5 runs from the over.
Back of a length, outside off. Paul Stirling hops and defends it to backward point.
Right into the blockhole, on middle. Paul Stirling jams it out to cover.
FOUR! Put away! Short ball, on middle. Paul Stirling swivel-pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Good-length ball, outside off, nipping in. Paul Stirling looks to drive but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Nothing on free hit! Length ball, on middle. Worked to square leg.
NO BALL! A full toss above waist high, on middle. Paul Stirling swings his bat but gets hit on the gloves. Free Hit coming up...
On the pads again, Paul Stirling clips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Good-length ball, on middle. Andy Balbirnie pushes it to mid off for a quick single.
On a length, on off. Punched off the back foot towards covers.
This is worked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On a length, on middle. Stirling keeps it out.
FOUR! On the pads, Stirling tickles it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Who will bowl from the other end? Imran Anwar it is.
FOUR! Dispatched! Short ball, on middle. Andy Balbirnie pulls it to deep mid-wicket for the second boundary of the over. A good start for Ireland! 11 runs off it.
Fuller in lengh, outside off. Paul Stirling steers it to deep point for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Andy Balbirnie cuts it to third man for a single.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Full and outside off, Andy Balbirnie leans onto it and drives it through cover-point to collect a boundary. He gets off the mark as well.
On a length, on off. Balbirnie taps it to point.
Back of a length, outside off. Stirling cuts it to deep point to get off the mark with a single.

We are set for the game to begin! The players have made their way out to the middle. Andy Balbirnie and Paul Stirling to open the batting for Ireland. Shahid Mahmood to start with the ball. Here we go...

Bahrain (Playing XI) - Muhammad Safdar (WK), Sarfaraz Ali (C), Muhammad Younis, Haider Ali Butt, Imran Anwar, Junaid Aziz, Umar Toor (In place of Umer Imtiaz), Sathaiya Veerapathiran, Shahid Mahmood, Waseeq Ahmed, David Mathias.

Ireland (Playing XI) - Lorcan Tucker (WK), Paul Stirling, Andy Balbirnie (C), Harry Tector (In place of Shane Getkate), Gareth Delany, Simi Singh, George Dockrell, Craig Young, Mark Adair, Andy McBrine, Josh Little.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and lands in the favor of Ireland. They have elected to BAT first.

Bahrain on the other hand, were professional in their performance against Germany and would be confident of getting a win here as well. They will be wary of the fact that Ireland are a much stronger opposition than Germany and won't be taking things for granted. They have a fantastic chance to make history here. Let's see if they are able to do so or not. Toss and team news in a bit.

Ireland haven't been showcasing their true potential for quite some time now and their struggles were there to be seen against the UAE. They would look to perform better as a unit in this do-or-die game. It is important for them that they don't panic after a single loss and gain some confidence with a win here.

Hello and welcome to the coverage of the ongoing T20 World Cup Qualifier A where Ireland will take on Bahrain in match 8. It's a must win for Andy Balbirnie and his troops while Bahrain has a chance to seal their spot in the semis. Let's see which team comes out on top.
